name: opera-incerta-monorepo
description: Opera Incerta — a local desktop tool for collecting and writing texts and assembling them into a structured book manuscript

scripts.check: pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck:tests && pnpm run test && pnpm run check:desktop-production && pnpm run check:assets
scripts.desktop:build: pnpm --filter @opera-incerta/workbench... run build && pnpm --filter @opera-incerta/desktop... run build
scripts.desktop:make: pnpm run desktop:build && pnpm --filter @opera-incerta/desktop run make
scripts.desktop:package: pnpm run desktop:build && pnpm --filter @opera-incerta/desktop run package
scripts.desktop:smoke: pnpm run desktop:build && pnpm --filter @opera-incerta/desktop run smoke
scripts.desktop:start: pnpm run desktop:build && pnpm --filter @opera-incerta/desktop run start
scripts.spike:editor: pnpm --filter @opera-incerta/spike-editor-codemirror... run build && pnpm --filter @opera-incerta/spike-editor-codemirror run spike
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck:tests
